reel.title: From terminal capture to polished Reel — in one command

card.title: From terminal capture to polished Reel — in one command

shots.label: inspect: fit lines narration to shots

narration.text: You shipped something, and now you need a video about it.
Every demo tool hands you a flat mp4.
LaunchReel reads a terminal recording you already know how to make.
One command, fully offline.
M3 plans the shots, narrates, scores, and assembles.
It starts by ingesting the cast file.
Every command and output is timestamped and ready.
Narration is fit to each shot.
The result is a structured Reel.
Music is the hard part.
Three candidates are generated and measured with librosa.
Track two wins because its first beat sits nearest the first cut.
And you get the project file, not just the mp4.
Reel.otio opens in a real editor, shot by shot.
No other tool in this space gives you that.
The report shows the plan and the beats it found.
Cuts land where the beats actually sit.
And it round-trips through FCPXML.
It ships with a recorded session and everything it generated.
The first run needs no setup.
The gate runs every check end to end.
Free and open source, MIT licensed.

music.caption: Upbeat electronic underscore with a clear four-on-the-floor pulse; intro sustains, then a steady beat carries the rest.
